metadata.title: Technical Support
metadata.description: A web application for submitting, tracking and resolving technical support requests.

home.title: Technical Support
home.subtitle: Report a problem, track its status and get an answer from the support team in one place.

create.title: Submit a request
create.description: Describe the problem and choose a category and priority.

track.title: Real-time tracking
track.description: Get notified as soon as the status changes or a reply arrives.

resolve.title: Fast resolution
resolve.description: The support team takes the request, talks to you and resolves it.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to report a problem and track your requests.

register.title: Sign up
register.description: Create an account to report a problem to the support team.
register.successText: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your account email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.successText: If an account with {email} exists, we sent a link to set a new password. Check your inbox.

reset.title: New password
reset.description: Enter a new password for your account.

auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.

validation.fullNameLength: Name must be between 2 and 100 characters.
validation.passwordWeak: Password must have at least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.
validation.passwordTooLong: Password can have at most 72 characters.
validation.passwordSame: The new password must be different from the old one.

profile.title: My profile
profile.passwordDescription: After the change, sign in with your new password.
profile.googleAccount: You sign in with Google, so this account has no password in the app.

placeholder.text: This page is under construction and will be available soon.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.text: This page is available to administrators only.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The data is not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.AUTH_CALLBACK_FAILED: Sign-in failed or the link has expired. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: Your account has been deactivated. Contact an administrator.
errors.NOT_ASSIGNED_AGENT: This ticket is not assigned to you.
errors.FORBIDDEN_INTERNAL_COMMENT: Only support team members can write internal notes.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Your email address is not confirmed yet. Check your inbox.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item does not exist.
errors.TICKET_NOT_FOUND: The ticket does not exist or you do not have access to it.
errors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: This status change is not allowed.
errors.TICKET_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: The ticket has already been taken by another agent.
errors.ASSIGNEE_NOT_AGENT: A ticket can only be assigned to an active support team member.
errors.TICKET_CLOSED: The ticket is closed and cannot be changed.
errors.ALREADY_RATED: This ticket has already been rated.
errors.TICKET_NOT_RESOLVED: A ticket can be rated only after it is resolved.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF: You cannot change the role or status of your own account.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

apiDocs.title: API documentation
apiDocs.description: All application API calls (OpenAPI 3). For calls that require sign-in, click “Authorize” and enter an access token (JWT).
